message:
docs(release): the candidate APK asks for a permission the deployed one does not

0.2.13 adds android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, which 0.2.12 does
not have -- the PackageInstaller path needs it. Intended, but a user sees a
new request to allow installing unknown apps, so it belongs in the release
record rather than being left to be discovered at install time.

It was missing from that record. Writing up the artifacts, I listed
versions and hashes and did not look at what the build asks the user for.
The verifier's check on the artifact caught it.
